headline: NUA Arquitectures renovates Catalan textile warehouse with timber office block
context: Spanish studio NUA Arquitectures has renovated a textile warehouse near Barcelona, using timber partitions to create a small office block within its concrete-and-brick structure. The project was completed for Tuvatèxtil, one of the last companies still operating in El Pont d'Arme

sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: Spanish studio NUA Arquitectures has renovated a textile warehouse near Barcelona, using timber partitions to create a small office block within its concrete-and-brick structure. The project was completed for Tuvatèxtil, one of the last companies still operating in El Pont d'Armentera – once the most important textile hub in southern Catalonia, home to 12 factories. The post NUA Arquitectures renovates Catalan textile warehouse with timber office block appeared first on Dezeen .
